|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 2). The images here, the release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image, print it. The current text is [[Jek Porkins (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1).
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 1 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 102)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 2. While piloting Red 6: it is Heroic, immune to attrition < 4, Jek draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise, and, during your control phase, may use 1 Force to retrieve a Rogue squadron pilot or an X-wing.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-102-Jek_Porkins.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-jekporkins-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 9)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character: a stale reprint, not a new version, and it does not make this text current again.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jek Porkins (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 1 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1210_102">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock1Type (Virtual Block 1 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “[Pilot] 2. While piloting Red 6: it is Heroic, immune to attrition < 4, Jek draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise, and during your control phase, may use 1 Force to retrieve a Rogue squadron pilot or an X-Wing.” '''What changed:''' Two changes: the comma after “and” is dropped (“and, during” becomes “and during”), and “X-wing” is written “X-Wing”, with a capital W. The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1210_102">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes.
